issue_updates.title: {identifier} updates
issue_updates.summary: Updates were made to the work item by {actor}.
issue_updates.summary_others: Updates were made to the work item by {actor} and others.
issue_updates.title_changed: The work item title has been updated to {title}
issue_updates.footer: This email was sent to {email}. If you'd rather not receive this kind of email, you can unsubscribe from the work item or manage your email preferences.

digest.title: Update digest
digest.footer: This is a summary of work item updates. You get mentions right away. Change notification settings.

due_reminder.title: Work item reminder
due_reminder.footer: This is an automated reminder sent every morning about work items due today and work items that are past their due date.

project_addition.subject: You have been invited to a Pi-Plane project
project_addition.preheader: {inviter} has invited you to the {project} project in {workspace} on Pi-Plane.
project_addition.heading: You've been invited to the {project} project on Pi-Plane
project_addition.intro: {inviter} has invited you to work with them in {project} in the workspace {workspace} on Pi-Plane.
project_addition.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
project_addition.note: Note: This email was sent to {email}. If you weren’t expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

access_request.subject: {requester} asked to join {project}
access_request.preheader: {requester} asked to join the private project {project} in {workspace} on Pi-Plane.
access_request.heading: Access request for the {project} project
access_request.intro: {requester} asked to join the private project {project} in the workspace {workspace} on Pi-Plane. You can approve or reject the request in the project's member settings.
access_request.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
access_request.note: Note: This email was sent to {email} because you are an admin or the lead of this project.

access_request_decision.subject_approved: Your request to join {project} was approved
access_request_decision.subject_rejected: Your request to join {project} was not approved
access_request_decision.intro_approved: {decider} approved your request to join the private project {project} in the workspace {workspace} on Pi-Plane. You can open it now.
access_request_decision.intro_rejected: {decider} did not approve your request to join the private project {project} in the workspace {workspace} on Pi-Plane. If you think this is a mistake, ask a project admin.
access_request_decision.note: Note: This email was sent to {email} because you asked to join this project.

one_time_code.subject: Your one-time Pi-Plane login code is {code}
one_time_code.preheader: Your Pi-Plane login code {code} is valid for 10 minutes.
one_time_code.heading: Your login code for Pi-Plane
one_time_code.info: This code is valid for the next 10 minutes. Enter it on the sign-in page to complete your login.
one_time_code.note: Note: This email was sent to {email}. If you were not expecting a sign-in code, you can safely ignore this message.

forgot_password.subject: A new password to your Pi-Plane account has been requested
forgot_password.preheader: Reset your Pi-Plane password with this secure link.
forgot_password.heading: Reset your Pi-Plane password
forgot_password.intro: We received a request to reset your Pi-Plane password. To reset your password, click the button below.
forgot_password.note: Note: This email was sent to {email}. If you weren’t expecting a password reset, you can safely ignore this email.

workspace_invitation.subject: {inviter} has invited you to join them in {workspace} on Pi-Plane
workspace_invitation.preheader: {inviter} has invited you to join {workspace} on Pi-Plane.
workspace_invitation.heading: Join {workspace} on Pi-Plane
workspace_invitation.intro: {inviter} has invited you to collaborate with them in {workspace} workspace on Pi-Plane.
workspace_invitation.note: Note: This invitation was intended for {email}. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

account_activated.subject: {name} has been activated on Pi-Plane
account_activated.heading: You are back inside Pi-Plane again.
account_activated.body: Your account is reactivated and you can now access your issues and other data if the project is still active. Alternatively, you can create a new workspace and start adding projects to it.

account_deactivated.subject: {name} has been deactivated on Pi-Plane
account_deactivated.heading: You are out of Pi-Plane now.
account_deactivated.body: You have deactivated your account successfully. Your issues, cycles, and other project data will still be accessible if the project is active and there are other members in it.

email_updated.subject: Pi-Plane email address successfully updated
email_updated.body: You have successfully updated your email address with Pi-Plane to {email}.
email_updated.login: You can now log in using this email address.

webhook_deactivated.subject: Webhook Deactivated
webhook_deactivated.message: Webhook {url} has been deactivated due to failed requests.

analytics_export.subject: Your Export is ready
analytics_export.preheader: Your requested Pi-Plane Analytics data export is attached as a CSV file.
analytics_export.heading: Your Pi-Plane Analytics export is ready
analytics_export.intro: Your requested data export from Pi-Plane Analytics is ready. We’ve attached it as a CSV file for your convenience.
analytics_export.hint: You can open the CSV in any spreadsheet or BI tool to analyze the data, build reports, or share insights with your team.

shared.recipient_note: This email was sent to {email}. Please delete if you aren't the intended recipient.
shared.fallback: If the button doesn’t work, copy and paste this link into your browser:
